create_optimizer_radamschedulefree: create a Schedule-Free RAdam optimizer with configurable learning rate, betas, and weight decay for PyTorch model training
switch_train_eval_mode: switch the RAdamScheduleFree optimizer between train and eval modes to update model parameters for evaluation
perform_optimization_step: perform a single optimization step with the RAdamScheduleFree optimizer including gradient updates and moving average tracking
configure_silent_sgd_phase: configure the RAdamScheduleFree optimizer to skip the early SGD phase for smoother warmup behavior during training
enable_foreach_acceleration: enable foreach-backed acceleration in the RAdamScheduleFree optimizer for faster and more memory-efficient parameter updates
